bio: Instructor Environmental Health, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Environmental Health Theodore (Ted) K. Courtney is Instructor in Injury, Safety, and Ergonomics in the Department of Environmental Health at the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health and the Harvard Education and Research Center for Occupational Safety and Health in the Environmental and Occupational Medicine and Epidemiology program in the Department. He has taught at the Harvard Chan School since 1995. Ted is also Technical Director, Casualty at The Hanover Insurance Group and President of TKC Consulting LLC. Ted previously was Vice President for Product Strategy at Concorde Health, Inc. a workplace safety, injury prevention and return to work focused start-up from 2019-2022. From 2018-2019, he was the Executive Director of the Football Players Health Study at Harvard University where he was responsible for administrative leadership of the FPHS research program funded by the NFL Players Association. From 2017 to 2018 Ted held a research appointment at MIT working with MIT Senseable City Lab and MIT Age Lab.
